about.title: About ArtAqua
body: ArtAqua is a brand of PostModerna, one of the first companies in Macedonia specialized in designer bathroom equipment, import, trade and installation.
Since 1997, the company has successfully operated on the Macedonian market and has become a recognizable brand offering high-quality services.
The modern design and high quality of the products reflect the goal of following the latest European trends while offering modern, functional and reliable bathroom solutions.
about.brands: The product range includes renowned Italian, Slovenian and Croatian manufacturers, including CERAMICA GRAVENA, GSG, HATRIA, FRIGES, REMER, FIORE, EFFEPI, KOLPA, REFLEX, ARMAL, UNITAS HERC, MINES and AQUAESTIL.
about.imageAlt: Part of the ArtAqua showroom with sanitary equipment and bathroom furniture

services.title: Our services
services.description: From product selection to installation and complete execution, ArtAqua connects bathroom equipment with practical solutions.
body: Professional service and strong technical knowledge of the products are key characteristics of the ArtAqua brand.
For products bought in the showroom, ArtAqua offers free delivery to your home in Skopje and professional installation.
In addition to sales and installation, the company can carry out the complete process of bathroom reconstruction in all of its stages.
ArtAqua installs hydro and aero massage systems and additional acrylic bath tub equipment such as underwater spotlights, heaters, chromotherapy and electronic displays.
